documents.title: Net sales
documents.text: Net sales are paid order amounts minus refunded amounts. Pending and cancelled orders are excluded. Values are stored as integer cents, not dollars.

documents.title: Available inventory
documents.text: Available inventory equals signed stock movements minus active reservations. Released reservations do not reduce availability. Aggregate movements and reservations separately before joining to avoid counting quantities multiple times.

documents.title: Unique purchasers
documents.text: Count distinct customer identifiers among paid orders. A person who buys several times counts once. Guest orders with a missing customer identifier are excluded.

documents.title: Monthly reporting interval
documents.text: Monthly reports use UTC timestamps. Include the first instant of the requested month and exclude the first instant of the next month. Do not use local machine time.

documents.title: Late delivery
documents.text: A shipment is late only when its actual delivery timestamp exceeds its promised delivery timestamp. Undelivered shipments are pending, not late completed deliveries.

documents.title: First human response
documents.text: Support response duration starts when the ticket is created and ends at the first staff reply. Exclude automated bot messages and customer follow-up messages. Tickets without a staff reply have no measured response duration.

documents.title: Unpaid invoice balance
documents.text: Calculate each invoice balance as its billed amount minus settled payments, floored at zero. Sum those nonnegative balances. Overpayment on one invoice must not cancel debt on another invoice.

documents.title: Reopened tickets
documents.text: A ticket is reopened only if an open event occurs after a closed event for that same ticket. Its initial open event does not count. Order events by their sequence number.
